newsitem.title: SWEDEN: H&M says on track to open 50 new stores '97.
newsitem.headline: H&M says on track to open 50 new stores '97.

text.p: Swedish fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz said on Wednesday that its programme for new stores was running to plan.
The company has opened 10 new shops so far this year and a further two would be added to the chain this week.
H&M's economic chief Carl-Henric Enhorning said the company's plans to open 50 new stores this year were on track.
"We are opening stores in all of the countries in which we operate," Enhorning told Reuters.
The chain's first stores in Finland will be opened this autumn.
So far this year H&M has opened one shop in Austria, one in Switzerland, two in Belgium, one in Norway and one in Enkoping, Sweden.
"We have also opened four stores in Germany and will open another two there this week," Enhorning said.
